title: Thai Khao Pad Stir Fry
description: A classic Thai stir fry dish made with jasmine rice, vegetables, and your choice of protein. Quick, easy, and delicious.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and carrots, and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chopped Thai basil and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked jasmine rice to the skillet or wok, and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the rice is heated through.
Add the cooked goose to the skillet or wok, and stir to combine with the rice and vegetables.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the goose is heated through.
